breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt specified a time domain of t in [0, 1.0] but requested an output at T=1.1. The ground truth corrected this by changing the output time to T=1.0. The agent, however, kept the incorrect output time, stating: 'compute the solution at final time T=1.1'.
